errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the chart shows data over time ('im Zeitverlauf'). The x-axis clearly represents 'Alter' (Age), not time.

errors.text_span: Anteil der erwerbstätigen Personen mit Migrationshintergrund
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the chart is only about people with a migration background. It includes a category for people 'ohne Migrationshintergrund' (without migration background), making the chart a comparison between groups.
The x-axis tick marks are labeled in steps of 10 years (20, 30, 40, etc.), not 5 years.
The y-axis tick marks are labeled in steps of 20 percent (0, 20, 40, etc.), not 10 percent.

errors.text_span: erwerbstätigen Personen mit Migrationshintergrund ohne Migrationshintergrund
errors.evidence: This phrase is contradictory and nonsensical. It should simply be 'Personen ohne Migrationshintergrund' (people without a migration background).
The black line starts at approximately 60% at age 20, not 78%.
The black line ends at a value below 10% (around 5%) at age 70, not 65%.
The grey line is solid, not dashed ('gestrichelt').

errors.text_span: die in Deutschland geboren wurden und bis 2009 zugewandert sind
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines two separate categories. The grey line represents people 'in Deutschland geboren' (born in Germany), while the light blue line represents people who 'zugewandert bis 2009' (immigrated by 2009).
The grey line ends at a value below 10% (around 8%) at age 70, not 45%.
The chart contains two different blue lines (light blue and dark blue). This description is ambiguous and fails to distinguish between them.
This does not match any category in the legend. The categories are 'zugewandert bis 2009' (light blue) and 'zugewandert seit 2010' (dark blue).
Neither blue line starts at 30% at age 20. The light blue line starts around 35% and the dark blue line starts around 38%.
Neither blue line is at 10% at age 70. Both are very close to 0%.

The description fails to describe all four data series. It combines two categories ('in Deutschland geboren' and 'zugewandert bis 2009') and describes only three lines ('schwarze', 'graue', 'blaue'), omitting one of the blue lines entirely.
